summary: Ran `npx -y -p @angular/cli@17 ng update @angular/core@17 @angular/cli@17 --allow-dirty --force` from EFNgApp/EFNgApp/ClientApp on Node 20/npm 10 (first installing node_modules, which were not present at hop start), bumping @angular/* to 17.3.12, the CLI/build-angular toolchain to 17.3.17, zone.js to 0.14.10, and TypeScript to 5.4.5. The CLI migration renamed the `browserTarget` options to `buildTarget` in angular.json. The hop file listed no related packages to bump, but the build then failed with TS2313 (circular constraint in @ngrx/effects' effect_creator.d.ts) because @ngrx/* was still on the 16.3.0 line, which does not support TypeScript 5.4; ran `ng update` for all five @ngrx/* packages to 17.2.0, whose own migration added `connectInZone: true` to the StoreDevtoolsModule.instrument() call in app.module.ts (reformatted for readability) to keep devtools working correctly with zone.js-based change detection. Install and build both pass; test fails the same pre-existing way as baseline and every prior hop (angular.json's test target points at a nonexistent root-level styles.css instead of src/styles.css); `npm run build:ssr` (not a required check) still reports the same two pre-existing, unrelated TS typing errors (@types/jasmine, @types/ws) verified present before this hop's changes too, so nothing new regressed.
changes: Upgraded typescript from ~4.9.5 to ~5.4.5 (pulled in by the Angular 17 CLI update)

Upgraded @ngrx/store, @ngrx/effects, @ngrx/router-store, @ngrx/store-devtools, @ngrx/entity from ^16.3.0 to ^17.2.0 (required to fix a TS2313 circular-constraint build error in @ngrx/effects against TypeScript 5.4; not listed in the hop file but necessary)
Angular CLI migration: renamed `browserTarget` to `buildTarget` in the serve and extract-i18n architect targets in angular.json
@ngrx/store-devtools migration: added `connectInZone: true` to StoreDevtoolsModule.instrument({ maxAge: 25 }) in src/app/app.module.ts
package-lock.json regenerated by npm as part of the update/install cycles
manual_followups: npm install still needs legacy-peer-deps (set project-wide via ClientApp/.npmrc in an earlier hop) because @nguniversal/module-map-ngfactory-loader@7.1.0 declares peers on @angular/core/@angular/platform-server ^7. It should move to an Angular-17-compatible replacement (the @nguniversal scope was merged into @angular/ssr from Angular 17 onward) in a later hop; the .npmrc override can likely be removed once it does.

`npm run test` fails before any spec executes because angular.json's test architect target still points at `styles.css` at the ClientApp root instead of `src/styles.css`; this predates this hop (present since baseline) and was left as-is per the rule that pre-existing failures don't need fixing.

`npm run build:ssr` (not a required check) reports two pre-existing TypeScript errors from @types/jasmine and @types/ws type-definition conflicts; verified present before this hop's changes too, so left as-is.

Angular 17 supports a new built-in control-flow syntax (@if/@for/@switch) but the core migration found no deprecated structural-directive patterns to convert automatically; existing *ngIf/*ngFor usage was left untouched per the smallest-correct-change rule.

src/app/app.server.module.ts still imports ModuleMapLoaderModule from @nguniversal/module-map-ngfactory-loader, and src/tsconfig.server.json still sets the deprecated `angularCompilerOptions.entryModule`; both are vestiges of the pre-Ivy Angular Universal template and should be reviewed/removed once the @nguniversal dependency is replaced with @angular/ssr.
